eyebrow: CISA ZTMM v2.0 — a fast refresher
code:
5 pillars:
  Identity | Devices | Networks
  Applications & Workloads | Data

3 cross-cutting capabilities:
  Visibility & Analytics
  Automation & Orchestration
  Governance

4 maturity stages:
  Traditional -> Initial -> Advanced -> Optimal
caption: You met this in security engineering as a checklist. Here it's a planning tool.

eyebrow: Why the assessment itself is an artifact
code:
A completed ZTMM baseline is architecture work because it is:

  Business-relevant   -> explains where risk concentrates
  Traceable           -> each score backed by evidence
  Decision-useful      -> drives sequencing elsewhere

Not just an engineering checklist.
caption: Business relevance + traceability + decision-usefulness = an architecture input.
